address: The Galleria Al Maryah Island, Level 2 Luxury Collection, South Plaza ADGM, Abu Dhabi
bio: This Abu Dhabi outpost of the global franchise is housed in The Galleria Mall on Al Maryah Island. The spacious interior with smartly laid tables has a large open kitchen with a counter – decorated with seasonal ingredients – wrapped around it. Mediterranean cuisine shines, with some highlights being the freshly made daily pasta, fish, chilled gazpacho and berry tart. Their lunch menu is great value and the a la carte offers something for everyone. The experience is completed with a lovely pianist belting out tunes all day.
